name: admin.usergroups.addTeams
purpose: Associate one or more default workspaces with an organization-wide IDP group.

team_ids.desc: A comma separated list of encoded team (workspace) IDs. Each workspace MUST belong to the organization associated with the token.

auto_provision.desc: When true, this method automatically creates new workspace accounts for the IDP group members.
